snippet.title: Huggy & Friends in Minecraft on Oct 14! - Mob Entertainment x Spark Universe Teaser
snippet.description: In partnership with Spark Universe, Huggy Wuggy, CatNap, and other Poppy Playtime experiments are coming to the Minecraft Marketplace on October 14!
